project.title: Project settings
project.description: Name, repo, workflow names, tab labels and targets the board reads. Written by refresh.py from the board config.

workers.title: Workers and threads
workers.description: Every worker: what it builds, where it runs, model, status and branch. Kept by the lead in workers_src.json.

needs_owner.title: Waiting on the owner
needs_owner.description: What needs the project owner, blocking or optional. Kept by the lead in needs_owner_src.json.

commits.title: Commits on main
commits.description: Commits to main over the refresh window (UTC), from the GitHub REST commits API.

branches.title: Branches against main
branches.description: Each pushed branch compared with main (GitHub compare API), plus local-only branches in the refresh clone.

runs.title: GitHub Actions runs
runs.description: The last 100 workflow runs from the Actions REST API, with duration in seconds.

checks.title: Latest checks on main
checks.description: Job results of the newest finished checks run on main, with test, sim and script counts from main's tree.

assets_glb.title: Asset files on main
assets_glb.description: Asset files of the configured type per folder under the assets directory on main.

goals.title: Goals vs measured
goals.description: The goals table from the configured markdown file, each status classed Met, Missed, Unmeasured, No target or Weak; rows tied to a workflow kept live from its runs.

balance.title: Balance studies
balance.description: Before/after win rates per matchup for each configured study.

balance_matrix.title: Balance matrix
balance_matrix.description: The balance matrix CSV from main once it exists; empty until then.

threads.title: Thread cost
threads.description: Per-thread cost in USD, tokens and wall clock from each thread's cloud session record (thread_costs.py).
threads.schedule: Daily cost routine, plus each lead refresh

threads_total.title: Thread cost total
threads_total.schedule: Daily cost routine, plus each lead refresh
